data.name: Kavayitri
data.gender_notes: Kavayitri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words 'kavi' (poet) and 'itri' (female poet or scholar). The name Kavayitri carries the meaning “Poetess or Scholar of Poetry” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kavayitri usually hope their child will grow to embody poetess or scholar of poetry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wisdom and creativity.
data.etymology: Kavayitri belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Poetess or Scholar of Poetry.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kavayitri total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
